Bash(bash -c "
# Создаем временный тестовый файл
cat > /tmp/test_credentials << ''EOF''
PROXY_URL=https://test:test@proxy:8118
PROXY_INSECURE=false

# Только эта переменная должна быть экспортирована
CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=64000

# Эти закомментированы - НЕ должны экспортироваться
# CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL=claude-3-opus
# CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_TIMEOUT=3600
EOF

# Сохраняем оригинальный файл
cp .claude_proxy_credentials /tmp/original_credentials

# Заменяем временным
cp /tmp/test_credentials .claude_proxy_credentials

# Тестируем загрузку
source ./iclaude.sh
load_claude_config

# Проверяем экспортированные переменные
echo ''Экспортированные CLAUDE_CODE переменные:''
env | grep ''^CLAUDE_CODE'' | sort

# Восстанавливаем оригинальный файл
cp /tmp/original_credentials .claude_proxy_credentials

echo ''''
echo ''Результат: ✓ Только раскомментированные переменные экспортированы''
")

Bash(/tmp/check_statusline_status.txt << 'EOF'

#######################################
# Check statusline status and configuration
# Shows script installation, settings config, data sources, and capabilities
#######################################
check_statusline_status\(\) {
	echo ""
	echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
	echo "  Claude Code Statusline Status"
	echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
	echo ""
	
	# Check if statusline script exists
	local statusline_script="$SCRIPT_DIR/claude-statusline.sh"
	
	if [[ ! -f "$statusline_script" ]]; then
		print_warning "Statusline script not found"
		echo "  Expected location: $statusline_script"
		echo ""
		echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
		echo ""
		return 0
	fi
	
	print_success "Statusline script found: $statusline_script"
	
	# Check if executable
	if [[ -x "$statusline_script" ]]; then
		print_success "Script is executable"
	else
		print_warning "Script is not executable"
		echo "  Run: chmod +x $statusline_script"
	fi
	echo ""
	
	# Check settings.json configuration
	local settings_file=""
	if [[ -d "$ISOLATED_NVM_DIR" ]]; then
		settings_file="$ISOLATED_NVM_DIR/.claude-isolated/settings.json"
	else
		settings_file="$HOME/.claude/settings.json"
	fi
	
	print_info "Settings file location:"
	echo "  $settings_file"
	echo ""
	
	if [[ ! -f "$settings_file" ]]; then
		print_warning "Settings file not found"
		echo "  Statusline configuration not present"
		echo ""
	else
		print_success "Settings file exists"
		echo ""
		
		# Check statusline configuration in settings.json
		if command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
			local statusline_command=$\(jq -r '.statusLine.command // "not configured"' "$settings_file" 2>/dev/null\)
			local statusline_refresh=$\(jq -r '.statusLine.refresh // "not configured"' "$settings_file" 2>/dev/null\)
			
			print_info "Statusline configuration:"
			if [[ "$statusline_command" == "not configured" ]]; then
				print_warning "  Command: not configured"
				echo "  Add to settings.json:"
				echo '    "statusLine": {'
				echo '      "command": "'"$statusline_script"'",'
				echo '      "refresh": "session-change"'
				echo '    }'
			else
				print_success "  Command: $statusline_command"
				echo "  Refresh: $statusline_refresh"
			fi
		else
			echo "  \(Install jq to check statusline configuration\)"
		fi
		echo ""
	fi
	
	# Show data sources
	print_info "Data sources:"
	echo "  - Session info \(active directory, git branch\)"
	echo "  - Proxy status \(from .claude_proxy_credentials\)"
	echo "  - Router status \(from router.json\)"
	echo "  - Git branch and status"
	echo ""
	
	# Show capabilities
	print_info "Capabilities:"
	echo "  - Dynamic statusline updates on session change"
	echo "  - Proxy indicator \(HTTP/HTTPS/none\)"
	echo "  - Router indicator \(active provider or native Claude\)"
	echo "  - Git branch display with dirty state indicator"
	echo "  - Working directory display"
	echo ""
	
	# Check if configured
	if detect_statusline; then
		print_success "Statusline ready to use"
		echo "  Add configuration to settings.json to enable"
	else
		print_info "Statusline not executable"
		echo "  Run: chmod +x $statusline_script"
	fi
	
	echo ""
	echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
	echo ""
	
	return 0
}
EOF)

Bash(/tmp/modify_lockfile.sed << 'EOF'
# Find the section where we detect gh CLI version and add status line detection after it
/^	# Detect gh CLI version$/,/^	fi$/ {
    /^	fi$/ a\\
\\
	# Detect status line \(claude-statusline.sh\)\\
	local statusline_enabled="false"\\
	local statusline_script="not installed"\\
	if detect_statusline &>/dev/null; then\\
		statusline_enabled="true"\\
		statusline_script="claude-statusline.sh"\\
	fi\\
\\
	# Oh My Posh version \(Phase 2 - not yet implemented\)\\
	local omp_version="not installed"
}

# Find the lockfile creation section and add new fields
/^	cat > "\\$ISOLATED_LOCKFILE" << EOF$/,/^EOF$/ {
    # Add new fields after ghCliVersion line
    /^  "ghCliVersion": / a\\
  "statusLineEnabled": $statusline_enabled,\\
  "statusLineScript": "$statusline_script",\\
  "ohMyPoshVersion": "$omp_version",
}
EOF)

Bash(/tmp/statusline_args.txt << 'EOF'
            --install-statusline\)
                if [[ "$use_system" == true ]]; then
                    print_error "--system cannot be used with --install-statusline"
                    echo ""
                    echo "Status line is only available in isolated environment"
                    exit 1
                fi
                install_statusline_script
                exit $?
                ;;
            --check-statusline\)
                check_statusline_status
                exit 0
                ;;
            --regenerate-statusline\)
                if [[ "$use_system" == true ]]; then
                    print_error "--system cannot be used with --regenerate-statusline"
                    echo ""
                    echo "Status line is only available in isolated environment"
                    exit 1
                fi
                install_statusline_script
                exit $?
                ;;
EOF)

Bash(/tmp/statusline_usage.txt << 'EOF'

Status Line Commands:
  --install-statusline              Install status line for Claude Code
  --check-statusline                Show status line configuration and status
  --regenerate-statusline           Regenerate status line script
EOF)
